quote: The driver of a motor vehicle shall: Exercise due care to avoid a collision with a person riding a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter.

activation.condition: A motor-vehicle driver encounters a person riding a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter where collision is possible.

obligation.description: Exercise due care to avoid a collision with that person.

timing.description: Throughout the possible conflict with that rider.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The statute supplies no numeric due-care cutoff; original person/bicycle qualification, actor response, collision and surrounding context require independent review.

parameter_refs.name: requested_longitudinal_response_trigger_distance
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: Engineering request for earlier or later response to measured forward gap in metres; not a legal due-care threshold
